description: Use this when a gym, studio or clinic owner asks about their own places on Phorme: what is listed, what is live, and how each place did, for example "how is my gym doing on Phorme?" or "did anyone book this week?". It returns each place the connected account lists, with its page and status, and its report: times shown by assistants, page views, asks held, bookings, requests, members and the share earned. A place on the free listing shows a little reach and what it missed; the rest is locked, the same as the web console. It reads only and changes nothing. It needs a connected Phorme account.
name: get_gym_report

claims.description: The account's open claims on places nobody ran: claim_id, place_id, place_name, status (code_sent or review), channel, sent_to (masked), expires_at.

next.description: What to tell the owner next.

places.description: Each place the account lists, as create_or_claim_place returns it.

report.description: One per place. tier free: views_30d, times_shown_30d, ai_check, missed (bookings, asked, members), asks_held, locked and plan_url. tier plan: times_shown, visits, assistant_reads_30d, clicks, bookings, requests, asks_held, members, share_earned_cents, ai_check, asked and funnel.

visits_unavailable.description: True when page visits could not be read just now.

title: Get my gym report
